top_signals.title: US Futures Gain as Earnings Roll in, Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stock-index futures gained as oil prices declined amid renewed hopes for a diplomatic solution to the US-Iran war, while positive results from companies including United Parcel Service Inc. and Coca-Cola Co. helped buoy market sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Argentina Denies Flávio Bolsonaro Entered the Country
top_signals.summary: The press secretary for Argentina’s President Javier Milei denied that Flávio Bolsonaro, the defeated candidate in Brazil’s presidential election, had entered Argentina.

top_signals.title: Wilson Pinpoints Clearing Events as Buying Opportunities
top_signals.summary: Mike Wilson, chief US equity strategist at Morgan Stanley, discusses the outlook for near-term market risks and their impact on his investment strategy. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
